scope: Add finite allowlisted page-local entry motion to the editor Canvas and public renderer, with reduced-motion support and a distinct Save, Preview, and Publish lifecycle.

controls: Responsive Inspector selects for motion.entry, motion.duration, and motion.easing.
Default motion is none; supported entry presets, durations, and easing values are exact allowlists.
Canvas and public renderer share STYLE_MAP and reject motion values outside the allowlist.
Editor and public page include the same finite low-amplitude keyframes; prefers-reduced-motion removes active animation and restores opacity/transform.
implementation.lifecycle: Browser acceptance verifies a motion change remains draft-only after Save and reload, appears in Editor Preview, reaches the public renderer only after Publish, and can be disabled in a new draft without mutating the live page until a second explicit Publish.
